content.rendered: [vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]We have extensive experience of mobile, modular and relocatable design. We understand imaging equipment perfectly and can help you design your mobile/relocatable unit to facilitate the equipment planning requirements whilst optimising the usability for the clinical staff, patient experience and workflow. We also understand that relocatable and modular units often have to be designed and built to meet current building regulations. We engage in the detail and fully in the design process, producing detailed specifications and full room data sheets from which accurate quotations can be prepared from multiple coach builders. Please review our gallery to view projects whereby we have been engaged in the design, implementation, project management and delivery of mobile, modular and relocatable facilities. Please contact us to discuss your specific requirements.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]
